14878500585843.title: DAISY DREAM
14878500585843.description:
Dreamy and delectable, Daisy Dream is an enchanting fragrance that captures the allure of soft florals and gourmand sophistication. Perfect for those who seek a scent that embodies both strength and femininity, this is your signature fragrance for every moment of indulgence.


Top Notes: The journey begins with the comforting richness of almond and coffee, intertwined with luscious fruity notes and a subtle touch of spice that adds a playful, alluring spark.

Heart Notes: At the heart lies a luxurious blend of jasmine sambac and tuberose, enriched with vanilla and amber, creating a luminous and comforting floral embrace.

Base Notes: The fragrance concludes with the depth of tonka bean, the richness of cocoa, and earthy vetiver, rounded out by sensual musk for a velvety, lasting finish.

14878500651379.title: PURPLE PEONIES
14878500651379.description:
Purple Peonies is a daring and sophisticated fragrance, perfect for those who embrace their individuality and the unexpected beauty of life’s contrasts. Dive into the enchanting world of a bold and unexpected blend that celebrates the allure of contrasts.

Top Notes: The fragrance opens with the unique green tang of tomato leaves, paired with the juicy sweetness of ripe raspberries and the warm, peppery nuance of shinus molle, setting a vibrant and intriguing tone.

Heart Notes: At the heart, Bulgarian rose reigns supreme, harmonized by delicate sweet notes, a whisper of spice, and the creamy depth of sandalwood, creating a captivating and multi-faceted floral core.

Base Notes: The scent deepens into a sultry base of earthy patchouli and sensual musky notes, leaving a lasting impression of elegance and mystery.

14878500684147.title: SAGE WHISPERS
14878500684147.description:
Sage Whispers is an invitation to immerse yourself in a fragrance of understated luxury, perfect for those who treasure subtle sophistication and timeless scents. A fragrance that embodies serene elegance and quiet sophistication, this classic fragrance is a delicate symphony of fresh citrus, floral radiance, and warm, earthy depth.

Top Notes: The journey begins with a zesty burst of lemon, invigorated by the spicy warmth of ginger, the fruity allure of cassis, and a bouquet of jasmine and white flowers that lend an ethereal freshness.

Heart Notes: The heart reveals a romantic interplay of peony, rose, and violet, softened by sweet nuances that create a dreamy, feminine character.

Base Notes: The composition settles into a sensual base of white musk, amber, patchouli, and creamy sandalwood, leaving a trail that is both grounding and irresistibly alluring.

14878500618611.title: WONDER ROSE
14878500618611.description:
Wonder Rose – A fragrance that unfolds like a blossoming bouquet, blending vibrant fruits, lush florals, and sensual woods. A sophisticated composition, this fragrance is perfect for those who seek a harmonious balance of freshness, romance, and depth in their signature scent.

Top Notes: The journey begins with a sparkling burst of pomegranate and fruity nuances, elevated by the zest of yuzu, creating an effervescent and captivating introduction.

Heart Notes: At its heart, a floral medley of peony, magnolia, and damascene rose radiates a velvety softness, evoking the timeless allure of a blooming garden.

Base Notes: The fragrance deepens into a warm and enduring base of amber, precious woods, creamy sandalwood, and musky undertones, leaving a trail that is both seductive and unforgettable.
